Research notes, Splash Software.

Surfaced while building out Lenex. The Splash Meet Manager stub had already flagged the
company as needing untangling; this page gives the vendor somewhere to live.

What is established:
  - The four Lenex sample files on swimrankings.net (dated 1 December 2024) name the

    string reads "Geologix Test User".
  - The Swimrankings wiki credits "Splash Meet and Team Manager" to Christian Kaufmann, the

  - Older Splash documentation hosted on the Swim Wiki (Meet_Manager_How-to-start.pdf) gives

  - SwimNews advertised "Splash Meet & Team Manager" from Oct-Nov 2001 (no. 268) through

    Early ads offered results in Splash's own format and SDIF; from May-June 2002 the list
    added Lenex, WSV, Aquabec and Commlink. The ads claimed nine interface languages and
    timing interfaces for Omega, Daktronics, Colorado, Alge and Longines.
  - A later "SwimNews Pro-Swim Meet Manager" (pro-swim.swimnews.com, copyright 2009 Archive

Unresolved: whether Splash Software GmbH succeeded GeoLogix AG, or the two coexist; the

Sources: swimrankings.net/files/example-*.lxf (CONSTRUCTOR element); wiki.swimrankings.net

This article is a stub. Splash Software is the Swiss publisher of
[Splash Meet Manager](../software/splash-meet-manager.md) and its team-management
counterpart, named as Splash Software GmbH of Spiegel bei Bern in files its program writes,
and its software is credited to Christian Kaufmann, who also maintains the
[Lenex](../software/lenex.md) format.

Older documentation places the product under GeoLogix AG of Berne, and the relationship
between the two companies is not yet established; see the [vendors index](index.md) for the
companies this section covers.
